name: Jogging
summary: A continuous, moderate-paced running gait performed for cardiovascular conditioning and aerobic endurance.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides, and gaze forward.
Engage your core lightly and maintain an upright posture with a slight lean forward from the ankles.
steps: Push off the ground with one foot, driving the opposite knee slightly forward in a controlled stride.
Land lightly beneath your center of mass with a midfoot strike, allowing the knee and ankle to absorb the impact.
Immediately transition to pushing off into the next stride, alternating legs in a fluid, rhythmic cycle.
Swing your arms naturally in opposition to your legs with elbows bent at approximately ninety degrees.
instructions.breathing: Breathe rhythmically and naturally through your nose and mouth at a conversational pace.
cues: Stay tall with a slight forward lean

common_faults.fault: Overstriding by reaching the foot far in front of the body with a heavy heel strike.
common_faults.correction: Shorten your stride and aim for a higher cadence so your feet land directly beneath your hips.

common_faults.fault: Hunching the shoulders and tensing the upper body.
common_faults.correction: Drop your shoulders away from your ears and keep your hands loosely cupped.

precautions: Wear well-fitted running shoes with adequate support and cushioning.
Increase weekly distance and duration gradually to prevent overuse injuries.
